'''Spacers Row''' was a street in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. [[Spaceport Express/Legends|Spaceport Express]] and [[Quebe-Luxfause Systems headquarters/Legends|Quebe-Luxfause Systems headquarters]] were located on this road. One of his ramifications was the [[Paradise Road/Legends|Paradise Road]].
